summary: Reviewed the user's 8-page Kyna Duo Business English Foundation T04 PDF 'Who's that?'. Produced the Vietnamese A1–A2 pre-class Markdown guide /mnt/data/duo_foundation_t04_whos_that_complete_study_notes.md (~1,212 lines; 26 main study sections), grounded in pages 1–8 and clearly labeling additional examples. Coverage: this/that, who's this/that, age, pronouns, family vocabulary, numbers, 25 sentence templates, 30 teacher questions, 10 sample dialogues, 4 speaking stories, 20/45/60-second speech templates, role-play, pronunciation, 50 self-tests with keys, slide 3 answers B/A/B/C, listening page 5 not verifiable without audio, and a source inconsistency (family example states four members but names five), plus a 30-minute plan.
